items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: But look, I was the only fella who could get something out of him. And everybody would work for him.

ctx.x: You know what I mean? He used to give a lot. Yeah. You know what I mean? But this fella here, this Italian fella, he never want to give nothing. Look, that man wouldn't know how he want to give you a drink of water. You hear me? I used to wait for him. See, you see like a drink? Man, he would never give you nothing to drink. But look, I was the only fella who could get something out of him. And everybody would work for him. He said, kid, you the only man can do something with that man. You know how I get him, Mr.…
